mapper.insert: INSERT INTO external_api_call_log ( provider, api_name, http_method, request_url, request_body, response_status, response_body, success, error_message, elapsed_ms, called_at ) VALUES ( #{provider}, #{apiName}, #{httpMethod}, #{requestUrl}, #{requestBody}, #{responseStatus}, #{responseBody}, #{success}, #{errorMessage}, #{elapsedMs}, #{calledAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, provider, api_name, http_method, request_url, request_body, response_status, response_body, success, error_message, elapsed_ms, called_at FROM external_api_call_log WHERE success = 0 ORDER BY called_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
